overview_description.description:
Xpence is the next generation smart business spend platform for MENAP businesses. Xpence empowers businesses with physical and virtual Visa payment cards to effortlessly manage their daily expenses.  

Xpence empowers businesses to take control of their spending. Employers can instantly issue physical and virtual prepaid Visa cards to their employees. They can set spending limits and rules for each card and track all company spending in real-time. Each time an employee uses their card, they're immediately reminded to capture the receipt by push notification. This means that with Xpence, companies can finally stop wasting time doing expense reports.

product.name: Xpence Account and Payment Account
product.description: A platform account setup for businesses and individuals to manage transactions, hold funds, and receive payouts.

product.name: Transaction Processing and Payment Acceptance
product.description: Service enabling merchants to conduct sales transactions and accept payments securely through various payment methods.

product.name: Funds Management and Payout Services
product.description: Service that manages received funds, holds them in pooled accounts, and disburses payouts to merchants' bank accounts.

product.name: Refunds, Returns, and Chargebacks Handling
product.description: A service that processes customer refunds, returns, and manages disputed transactions through chargebacks.

product.name: Merchant Onboarding and Compliance Verification
product.description: Service for registering merchants, verifying business and personal information, and ensuring compliance with legal and network requirements.
